component.name: Post & Pakete
component.summary: Announced letters and parcels – DHL, Hermes, DPD, GLS, UPS, Amazon
Angekündigte Briefe und Pakete – DHL, Hermes, DPD, GLS, UPS, Amazon

description.p: Shows the letters announced by Deutsche Post (via Home Assistant) and your parcels: enter a tracking number and Post & Pakete fetches status, history and a map – with several providers in turn (DHL, UPS, 17TRACK, Ship24, public pages), so one can step in for another. Optionally connects to Home Assistant (integration “Briefankündigung”) to also show the parcels from your shipping mails.
